patterns.description: Cards sobre restricciones de payout co-ocurren consistentemente: SC-R1-011 (pricing_page), SC-R1-024, SC-R1-025, SC-R1-027, SC-R1-028 (help_center) documentan desde distintas fuentes oficiales que el método de pago varía por país y que sellers en países sin direct deposit ni PayPal no pueden recibir pagos. Todos actores=platform.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-011: Gumroad pricing page: how sellers are paid varies by country (direct deposit or PayPal)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-024: Gumroad help center: if direct deposit and PayPal both unavailable in seller's country, no way to pay seller
signal_summaries.SC-R1-025: Gumroad help center: Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, wire transfer not supported as payout methods
signal_summaries.SC-R1-027: Gumroad help center: 160+ countries supported; payout by country (direct bank or debit vs verified PayPal)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-028: Gumroad help center: if PayPal unsupported in seller's country, Gumroad cannot pay them; Payoneer/wire/bitcoin unavailable

patterns.routing_rationale: All 5 signal IDs have actor=platform. Co-occurrence consistent across source types (pricing_page + help_center). However, the cluster generates no DT question because the phenomenon is entirely on one side (platform policy only) with no seller-side documented experience in this corpus. The affected population (sellers in unpaid countries) is undocumented. Route to rejected_grouping: consistent co-occurrence but no DT question — the absence of the affected actor makes this a coverage gap, not a co-occurrence tension.

components.label: Cluster — restricciones de payout por geografía
components.summary: Platform-only documentation of payout restrictions by country; seller-side experience not documented in corpus

patterns.description: Cards sobre estructura de fees multi-canal co-ocurren con cards de percepción y comportamiento de sellers: SC-R1-005 (pricing_page, platform) documenta 10%+$0.50; SC-R1-006 (pricing_page, platform) documenta 30% via Discover; SC-R1-036 (help_center, platform) documenta 40% via mobile app; SC-R1-044 (blog, source) observa rango efectivo 8-20%; SC-R1-047 (blog, seller) reporta $16.59 en fees de $110; SC-R1-061 (blog, seller) migra por fees altas. Cluster abarca source_types: pricing_page, help_center, blog; actors: platform, source, seller.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-005: Gumroad pricing page: 10% + $0.50 per transaction for standard sales
signal_summaries.SC-R1-006: Gumroad pricing page: 30% fee for sales via Gumroad Discover marketplace
signal_summaries.SC-R1-036: Gumroad help center: 40% total fee for mobile app sales (10% Gumroad + 30% App Store/Google Play)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-044: Blog (comparative commentary): effective fee range of 8% to 20% observed depending on price point and country
signal_summaries.SC-R1-047: Seller blog: paid $16.59 in fees from $110 total sales with commentary on fee growth at higher volumes
signal_summaries.SC-R1-061: Seller blog: perceived Gumroad fees as high; migrated back to Lemon Squeezy once approved

patterns.routing_rationale: Cluster spans multiple source types (pricing_page, help_center, blog) and multiple actor values (platform, source, seller). Different actor values present. Cross-source co-occurrence confirmed. Generates DT question: how does the multi-tier fee structure (10% standard, 30% Discover, 40% mobile) map onto seller perception and platform migration decisions? Understanding this relationship would change a design decision about fee structure transparency and channel incentives.

components.label: Cluster A — estructura de fees oficial por canal
components.summary: Platform-documented fee tiers: 10%+$0.50 standard, 30% Discover, 40% mobile app

components.label: Cluster B — percepción y comportamiento de sellers ante fees
components.summary: Seller/source-side: observed effective range 8-20%, actual fee impact on margin, migration away from platform citing fees

patterns.description: Cards sobre política de merchant of record co-ocurren con cards sobre control unilateral de reembolsos y condiciones de pago al seller: SC-R1-015, SC-R1-016, SC-R1-017 (policy_page, platform) documentan la estructura de merchant of record; SC-R1-018, SC-R1-034 (policy_page/help_center, platform) documentan control unilateral de refunds; SC-R1-046 (blog, seller) documenta experiencias de delayed payouts y suspensiones.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-015: Gumroad ToS: platform enables sellers to appoint Gumroad as non-exclusive reseller of eligible digital products
signal_summaries.SC-R1-016: Gumroad ToS: Gumroad holds sole discretion over eligible product categories; merchant of record for all resales; sellers prohibited from invoicing buyers
signal_summaries.SC-R1-017: Gumroad ToS: Gumroad Fee auto-deducted; remainder paid to seller on settlement schedule subject to change at Gumroad's discretion
signal_summaries.SC-R1-018: Gumroad ToS: sellers responsible for reimbursing Gumroad for refunds, chargebacks, and disputes
signal_summaries.SC-R1-034: Gumroad help center: platform reserves right to issue refunds within 90 days even if seller has no-refund policy
signal_summaries.SC-R1-046: Seller blog: many users faced delayed payouts, poor customer support, account suspensions without clear reasons

patterns.routing_rationale: Cluster spans source types (policy_page, help_center, blog) and actor values (platform: SC-R1-015/016/017/018/034; seller: SC-R1-046). Different actor values → passes same-actor filter. Cross-source confirmed. Generates DT question: how does the merchant-of-record structure (platform retains unilateral control over refunds, product eligibility, and settlement schedule) interact with documented seller experiences of loss of control over income? Understanding this relationship informs design decisions about seller autonomy and trust.

components.label: Cluster A — estructura de merchant of record y control unilateral de plataforma
components.summary: Platform retains sole discretion over eligibility, refund rights, settlement timing, and seller reimbursement obligations

components.label: Cluster B — experiencias de sellers con control de ingresos
components.summary: Seller-reported: delayed payouts, unexplained suspensions, difficulty recovering funds
